free_tier.stated: 2,500 build-minutes a month per billing account on e2-standard-2 (2 vCPU, 8 GB memory) in the default pool, stated as a promotional free tier whose limit is subject to change; the first 100 GB of worker SSD is free

egress.terms: network egress from builds is charged at standard Google Cloud rates; no egress allowance is stated for Cloud Build

interface_detail: gcloud builds submit (the Google Cloud CLI) and the Cloud Build REST API at cloudbuild.googleapis.com; no SSH into build workers is documented on the pages read
tooling: the gcloud CLI (gcloud builds submit) and the REST API

limits.value: 2,500 build-minutes a month per billing account on e2-standard-2 in the default pool, promotional and subject to change; beyond it e2-standard-2 costs $0.006 a minute
the first 100 GB of worker SSD is free; up to 4,000 GB can be attached

limits_note: the default pool allows 10 to 30 concurrent builds (global) and 5 to 100 concurrent E2 CPUs per region as project quotas

identity_cost.detail: a Google Cloud billing account is required for the Free Tier, including the Cloud Build minutes; the Free Trial sign-up that creates one requires a credit card or other payment method, and in some countries a bank-account verification

confidence_note: documented from the Cloud Build pricing page and the Google Cloud free-features page; the pricing page calls the build-minute allowance promotional and subject to change, which is a weaker commitment than a tier
